ability.name: Step 6 — Targeted Service Fingerprinting
ability.description: Performs quick local service queries to grab banner responses on potential AD Domain Controllers.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){ni -ItemType Directory -Force $d|out-null}; $(try { if (Test-Path "C:\Windows\Temp\bas\live_hosts.txt") { $hosts = Get-Content "C:\Windows\Temp\bas\live_hosts.txt" } else { $hosts = @("192.168.187.1", "192.168.187.141", "192.168.127.22") }; foreach ($ip in $hosts) { try { $de = New-Object System.DirectoryServices.DirectoryEntry("LDAP://$ip") ; $dn = $de.Properties["defaultNamingContext"].Value; if ($dn) { Write-Output "LDAP_IP: $ip | DN: $dn" } } catch {} }; "Banner grabbing completed" } catch { "ERROR: $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath C:\Windows\Temp\bas\step6_out.txt

rationale: Queries LDAP RootDSE natively on confirmed live hosts to gather domain naming contexts.
